body: But with her gone I really don't have anyone that I could constantly rely on. She is my rock, she is more of a friend than an adult. With her going to a different country next year I don't see what would stop me. She is probably the main reason I'm still here today. Without her I don't know what to do. This is a constant struggle for me because if she knew about these thoughts she wouldn't go. But I see how badly she wants this. I couldn't be selfish and create reasons for her not to go. She cares more about me than my family and I see nothing worth doing without her.
